id: title:TueHaulund:index observations by team and session

review.posthog_relevance: Replay observation queries filtering by team and session, potentially improving performance for recording cleanup or alert-engine observation windows.
review.reason: Adds a database index on team and session_id fields, executed via a migration that supports concurrent addition without locking the table. This could improve query performance for replay observation queries, though the exact benefit depends on query patterns not shown.
review.uncertainty: The actual performance gain and relevance to specific PostHog workloads are not demonstrated by the code alone; this is a potential optimization rather than a demonstrated fix or new capability.

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a database migration and model update. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F3.H1 are complementary: P1.F3.H1 adds the index definition to the model, while P1.F1.H1 executes the migration. P1.F2.H1 updates the migration marker. No tier assignment is made here as this is a preparatory step for scoring.
